_comment: jackie_messages.json — the WORDS Jackie texts. Single source of truth for the SMS pipeline:
tools/gen_messages.py writes the .journal, the localization and mod/JackieLives/messages_index.lua
from this file, and asserts that the three can never disagree (check_parity).
Schema + field rules: docs/research/messages_port_spec.md §7. Traps: §8.
TWO KINDS OF BEAT LIVE HERE.
* AMBIENT beats (opener/checkin/question/invite/standup/afterdate/outgoing) are drawn at random
by the scheduler in messages.lua. Their words are authored here and nowhere else.
* STORY beats (kind: "story") belong to the questline in mod/JackieLives/storyboard.lua. Their
words live THERE, verbatim, inside the arc beat's `sms = { ... }` block, and are copied here so
the generator can bake them into the archive. THE STORYBOARD WINS: if the two ever disagree,
tools/audit_messages.py fails and the storyboard is the side to copy FROM. The scheduler never
draws a story beat — arc.lua fires it by name with Msg.sendStory(id).
⚠️ Editing this file alone changes NOTHING in game. python3 tools/gen_messages.py, then
`python tools\build_archive.py` ON WINDOWS. The text is baked into JackieLives.archive.
Jackie is ALREADY a vanilla journal contact (id `jackie`, 5 prologue conversations), and
ArchiveXL MERGES a journal by id chain rather than replacing it — proven by the Panam Romance
Messages mod, which hangs new conversations under vanilla `panam`/`mitch`/`saul` and leaves the
vanilla threads working. So we hang ONE new conversation, `jackielives`, under his real contact:
his real face, his real name, one thread. `jackielives` is not among his five vanilla
conversation ids (q001_waiting_after_victor, q003_all_foods_come_back, q004_status_update,
q003_all_foods_before, q001_left_jackie_car), which is the one id that must never collide.
avatar 121253599929 is his own portrait, stored by the engine as a bare uint64.
flatLayout false ON PURPOSE: vanilla `jackie` has it unset and five real conversations, and flat
layout would restyle his prologue threads. Flat is right only for a contact who is ONLY ours.
If merging into vanilla `jackie` ever misbehaves in game, the fallback is one line of content —
{ "id": "jackielives_jackie", "conversation": "thread", "flatLayout": true } — and everything
downstream (journal, index, Lua) regenerates from it.

_comment: TIER 0 ON PURPOSE, and there must always be at least two of these. The outgoing pool is the
only part of the thread a player can reach on demand, and when it empties the bag refills and
immediately re-offers the beat V just used — which reads as the thread not responding. Two at
tier 0 is the floor; tools/test_messages.lua section 13 fails the moment it drops below.

_comment: Verbatim from mod/JackieLives/storyboard.lua. DO NOT EDIT HERE — edit the storyboard, re-copy,
and tools/audit_messages.py will tell you the moment the two disagree. Ids match the
storyboard's `sms.id` exactly, because arc.lua fires them by that name.
PART 1 — beat p1_sms_night, "The text". Four in the morning, and the ask that makes V complicit.

_comment: PART 3 — beat p3_blackout, "Ten minutes". No replies BY DESIGN: the two texts are twelve
minutes apart and he has no memory of the first. The player is meant to notice the timestamps,
not to answer. p3_timestamps pays it off in dialogue.
bubbles: at mistys. come by when you're done

bubbles: vik's got a table free thursday
he says it's my call which way we go
i've been sat here four hours and i can't do it. i keep pickin the one that keeps me useful to you and then i think that's not me thinkin, that's the thing in my head, and then i'm back at the start
whatever you pick i'll sign it. no hard feelins. i mean that
